thread:
sarah: partner wants their open LLM in our marketplace; asks: quantized inference builds allowed, marketplace SKUs, and a joint announcement. looping legal + eng.

 tom_legal: please attach license and callouts for derivative binaries; need country-of-origin for export check.

 sarah: vendor allows inference-only distribution, wants quantized variants (8/4-bit), forbids raw checkpoint resale.

 claire_prod: desired announce week 2026-04-21; need logo/blurb/landing page and co-branded webinar 2w after.

 maya_ops: operations note: we'll need approved quant profiles to validate accuracy and latency; private VPC deploys may need KMS/SSO details.

 raj_eng: concern: vendor quant tools include restrictive clauses; confirm we can ship optimized kernels referencing quant weights and provide conversion scripts for testing.

 tom_legal: draft clause: "Vendor grants Redwood non-exclusive rights to produce/distribute quantized variants for inference and marketplace distribution. Redistribution of raw checkpoints for resale is prohibited. Quantization profiles and accuracy baselines to be agreed; material accuracy regressions require vendor consent."

 sarah: vendor requests 7-day embargo after collateral finalization (prefers 2026-04-28). we can stage tile earlier but no public announce.

 ethan_partner_ops: we'll deliver logos, GDPR/PII attestations, MPN ID, and export appendix by Thu. embargo flexible.

 maya_ops: if embargo 4/28, need quant profiles by Wed to finish staging validation Thu-Fri.

 raj_eng: plan: run Redwood optimized kernel pass and vendor-generic baseline; report throughput, tail latency, L2 delta.

 tom_legal: also need export compliance appendix listing jurisdiction restrictions; vendor, please confirm dataset license restrictions.

 ethan_partner_ops: model trained in EU; some third-party datasets restrict sanctioned regions. will provide appendix and redline Wed.

 claire_prod: plan: Wed = legal redline + quant profiles, Thu-Fri = staging validation, Fri = sign-off. announce week 4/21 or 4/28 based on embargo. I'll prep comms and webinar brief.

 sarah: action owners: Tom=legal, Raj/Maya=perf & staging, Ethan=vendor deliverables, Claire=comm. ping when done.

 announce-bot: Reminder: open release ticket in #release-war-room once legal uploads signed redline.

 sarah: thanks all.
